cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You apologised for missing my concert. What do you think the empty seat felt like?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I know the timetable. I'm asking about the seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you saw me look at the door before the encore. Can you understand how it felt to keep expecting you?

mechanism: A copies apparent emotional composure without understanding its cue, then asks B to acknowledge the specific hurt beneath that performance.
confusable: D51 demands rank apology; D75 asks recognition of emotional cost, not merely missed event or broken phone.
comparison: Missed concert and recording versus weeks without a reply.
seedUse: Preserve B real explanations and partial acknowledgment as material for a more specific request.
